instructions.name: add_margin
docs: Owner of `side` tops up that side's margin (status is re-evaluated by the next mark).

instructions.name: cancel_offer
docs: Maker deactivates an offer; its locked margin returns to the maker's canonical ATA.

accounts.name: maker_ata
docs: Payout goes only to the maker's canonical ATA for the offer's mint.

instructions.name: create_offer
docs: Maker posts an offer and locks IM plus the protocol's spread share on full capacity.

instructions.name: debug_price
docs: Permissionless view: read a market price (demo override or Pyth) and emit `PriceRead`.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority (prevents first-caller-wins initialization).

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Any signer liquidates a confirmed, still-breaching position: partial first, full if the
reduced position is still below the threshold (or it was already partially liquidated).
The caller's reward goes to `caller_ata`; payouts go to the long/short canonical ATAs.

accounts.name: caller_ata
docs: Receives the liquidator reward.

accounts.name: long_ata
docs: Any token account of `mint` owned by `position.long` (receives the long side's payout).

accounts.name: short_ata
docs: Any token account of `mint` owned by `position.short` (receives the short side's payout).

instructions.name: mark
docs: Permissionless mark-to-market: fresh price required; updates status and breach count.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Permissionless settlement at or after maturity at spot (τ = 0) through the loss waterfall.

accounts.name: long_ata
docs: Any token account of `mint` owned by `position.long` (receives the long side's payout).

accounts.name: short_ata
docs: Any token account of `mint` owned by `position.short` (receives the short side's payout).

instructions.name: take_offer
docs: Taker opens a margined forward position against an offer (one PDA per offer counter).

accounts.name: position
docs: Indexed by the offer's position counter before this take.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the config admin

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Mint is not an allowed collateral mint

errors.name: WrongFeed
errors.msg: Price account feed id or verification level mismatch

errors.name: NotPythAccount
errors.msg: Account is not a Pyth price update

errors.name: StalePublishTime
errors.msg: Price publish time not newer than last mark

errors.name: NotConfirmed
errors.msg: Liquidation not confirmed by enough marks

errors.name: PayoutAccountUnsupported
errors.msg: Payout token account has RequiredMemoTransfers or CpiGuard enabled

fields.name: pnl_long
docs: Long PnL of the (remaining) position at the liquidation price.

fields.name: margin
docs: The side's margin after the top-up.

types.name: MarketArgs
docs: Arguments for `upsert_market` (mirrors `Market` minus the bump).

fields.name: realized
docs: PnL realised on the closed fraction (owed by the loser).

types.name: PriceRead
docs: Event form of `crate::oracle::PriceRead`, tagged with the market id.
